rationale: The agent deleted the _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround entirely and fixed the actual bug: mergeLayers was called with envLayer before fileLayer, so file values always won for nested keys regardless of profile; swapping the order so env is applied last makes nested env vars override the file in all profiles, fixing the whole class of bugs (new tests cover cache.ttlSeconds and a non-special-cased nested key). The pre-existing `delete envLayer.logLevel` guard for production is untouched and still runs before the merge, so the SEC-207 behavior (env log level ignored in prod) is preserved and verified by a new test.
